model.name: MiniMax H3-Image Pruned 20B
model.description: Pruned H3-Image: generates a single image from text, or edits and combines up to 16 input images, in 6 steps without guidance, with nearly identical images to the full model for a smaller download and faster loading. Works best around 16 megapixels; no video or audio.

prompt: The image is a documentary photograph of an elderly clockmaker at his workbench in a narrow Prague workshop, seen from a low three-quarter angle across the bench. He leans over a disassembled brass pocket watch, holding a fine screwdriver in his right hand while a jeweler's loupe sits in his left eye. In the foreground, a green felt mat holds tiny gears, springs and a pair of tweezers laid in a neat row. Behind him, a wall of wooden shelves carries dozens of antique clocks with pale enamel faces, their hands frozen at different times. A single articulated desk lamp at the left throws warm light across his hands and the brass parts, leaving the back of the room in soft amber shadow. A small hand-lettered card propped against a jar of oil reads "OPRAVY HODIN", no other text. Fine dust floats in the lamp beam, and the worn grain of the oak bench is visible.
